issues.issue: Can the deemed-discontinued ALJR be revived by an extension of time without a request to re-open or exceptional circumstances?
issues.applicant_position: Solicitor's error in missing the record deadline should excuse the delay; extension sought to file the application record.
issues.respondent_position: The ALJR was deemed discontinued; no re-opening request and no exceptional circumstances under Virk.
issues.result_quote: As such, the motion is denied on that ground alone.

issues.issue: Has the applicant shown a continuing intention to pursue the application?
issues.applicant_position: Solicitor's affidavit supports the motion and shows continuing intention.
issues.result_quote: The affidavit from the Applicant’s counsel fails to disclose any reason why the Applicant has not provided evidence speaking to his continuing intention to proceed

issues.issue: Does the underlying application have merit?
issues.applicant_position: Solicitor's affidavit supports the merit of the underlying application.
issues.result_quote: The Court was not provided with copy of the decision under review, nor the alleged errors believed to exist in the decision.
